title: Would definitely recommend!
text: We had the best experience with Bennetta! She is super knowledgeable about gin and has such a fun, lighthearted personality! The two places we went to had such wonderful atmospheres. I feel so lucky to have met such a wonderful local who not only kept us super entertained but also gave us wonderful advice for our futures! 10/10 experience and will 100% be recommending to anyone I know traveling to Barcelona.
author: Aria_H

title: Amazing
text: Absolutely INCREDIBLE. We were greeted by Sebastian, who was friendly, professional and talented. The cocktails were beyond anything expected. 10/10 would recommend.
author: Nikola_kaminska

title: A Unique Experience in an Amazing City
text: If you enjoy unique bars, delicious cocktails and learning a little in the process, this is the tour for you! We experienced three bars we never would have found, had some amazing gin drinks and learned some fascinating history about Spain and gin.
author: Venture384334

title: So much fun!!
text: We experienced six unique and delicious gin cocktails and three great bars on this highly recommended tour.  I've never been a huge fan of gin, but I have a new appreciation.  Don't miss it!
author: Pamela P
